args.sql:
SELECT 
    a.accindex AS account_id,
    sb.sesscount AS session_tally,
    cb.postfreq AS overall_posting_speed,
    1 AS fixed_platform_count,
    sd.detection_score_profile->'overall'->>'riskval' AS cross_risk_score
FROM 
    account a
JOIN 
    profile p ON a.accindex = p.profaccref
JOIN 
    sessionbehavior sb ON p.profkey = sb.sessprofref
JOIN 
    contentbehavior cb ON sb.sessref = cb.cntsessref
JOIN 
    securitydetection sd ON cb.cntref = sd.secdetkey
ORDER BY 
    sb.sesscount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    a.accindex AS account_id,
    sb.sesscount AS session_tally,
    cb.postfreq AS overall_posting_speed,
    1 AS fixed_platform_count,
    sd.detection_score_profile->'overall'->>'riskval' AS cross_risk_score
FROM 
    securitydetection sd
JOIN 
    contentbehavior cb ON sd.secdetkey = cb.cntref
JOIN 
    sessionbehavior sb ON cb.cntsessref = sb.sessref
JOIN 
    profile p ON sb.sessprofref = p.profkey
JOIN 
    account a ON p.profaccref = a.accindex
ORDER BY 
    sb.sesscount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    a.accindex AS account_id,
    sb.sesscount AS session_tally,
    cb.postfreq AS overall_posting_speed,
    1 AS fixed_platform_count,
    sd.detection_score_profile->'overall'->>'riskval' AS cross_risk_score
FROM 
    account a
JOIN 
    profile p ON a.accindex = p.profaccref
JOIN 
    sessionbehavior sb ON p.profkey = sb.sessprofref
JOIN 
    contentbehavior cb ON sb.sessref = cb.cntsessref
LEFT JOIN 
    moderationaction ma ON cb.cntref = ma.macntref
LEFT JOIN 
    securitydetection sd ON ma.masedetref = sd.secdetkey
ORDER BY 
    sb.sesscount DESC
LIMIT 1;
